correctness.rationale: Exact fixed-coin interval I_t=[kt+ceil(t/p),kt+floor(2t/p)] shows first nonempty interval I_h at hk+1 and all subsequent intervals nonempty and ordered. Consecutive lengths d_t=k+floor(t/p)-floor(2t/p) are positive for precisely p indices at each length k-j, j=1..k-1, and never thereafter. Thus initial length hk plus p copies of each smaller length are exhaustive. Sum gives genus, last positive gap gives Frobenius. An independent modular criterion enumerates 975 pairs p<=40,k<=25 and 246675 runs with complete agreement. Proof covers all integer pairs, including k=1.

value.rationale: Maximal consecutive-gap block lengths form a meaningful local complement invariant not determined by numerical-semigroup genus or Frobenius number. The complete uniform all-modulus histogram, exactly p occurrences of every short length 1..k-1 plus one initial long run, generalizes beyond already-studied special-modulus Apéry descriptions and identifies a structural law across a naturally parameterized infinite class of proportionally modular semigroups. It is not an arbitrary fixed finite cutoff, and the all-length statement is not mere recomputation of global invariants.
